questions.question: How long is it from 07:30 to 14:15? Show how you count on.
questions.expected_answer: From 07:30 to 08:00 is 30 minutes. From 08:00 to 14:00 is 6 hours, and from 14:00 to 14:15 is 15 minutes. Altogether that is 6 hours and 45 minutes.

questions.question: How many decades are there from 1994 to 2024?
questions.expected_answer: 2024 minus 1994 is 30 years. A decade is 10 years, so 30 years is 3 decades.

questions.question: If 1 September is a Monday, what day is 24 September? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: Add 7 days at a time: 8, 15 and 22 September are also Mondays. Then 23 September is a Tuesday and 24 September is a Wednesday.
